title: feat(studio): enforce package namespace prefix at authoring time (framework#2694)
body:
Console-side companion to **framework#2694** (publish-time namespace-prefix enforcement). Gives Studio authors the compliant object namespace at *design* time so they never build a prefix-less object and only discover it when publish rejects the batch (code `NAMESPACE_PREFIX`).

Reuses the two spec-owned helpers from `@objectstack/spec/kernel` (`deriveNamespaceFromPackageId`, `validateObjectNamespacePrefix`) — no re-implemented derive/validate dialect (AGENTS.md #0/#0.1).

> Note: the issue was written when this was blocked on a spec publish (anticipated 12.7.0). That blocker is resolved — the repo is already on `@objectstack/spec@^14.6.0`, which ships both helpers, so no dep bump was needed.

## Changes (all in `packages/app-shell`)

- **packages-io**: `PkgEntry` exposes `namespace` (explicit `manifest.namespace` wins, else back-derived from the id); `createBasePackage` threads a `namespace` param into the POST manifest; adds `NAMESPACE_RE` + a `prefixObjectName()` helper built on `validateObjectNamespacePrefix`.
- **BuilderLanding** + **PackagesPage `CreatePackageDialog`**: new `namespace` field — defaults to the id-derived value, tracks the package-id input until the user edits it (derived during render, no effect), editable, validated against `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,19}$`, posted in the manifest.
- **StudioDesignSurface "+ new object"**: reads the current package's namespace and auto-prefixes the identifier with `<namespace>_`, never double-prefixing an already-compliant or exempt (`sys_*`) name.
- **i18n**: EN/ZH strings for the namespace label, hint, and invalid message.

Publish-failure display already surfaces the `NAMESPACE_PREFIX` error inline via `formatPublishFailures` / `formatMetadataError` (confirmed, not rebuilt).

## Acceptance

- ✅ New writable package: `namespace` defaults to the id-derived value, tracks the id until touched, editable + validated.
- ✅ New object: identifier auto-prefixed with the package namespace; already-compliant names not double-prefixed.
- ✅ Bypassing the UI (prefix-less object via API) → publish surfaces the `NAMESPACE_PREFIX` message inline.
- ✅ No renderer-side re-implementation of the rule — both come from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`.

## Tests

- Unit: `parsePackages` namespace resolution + `prefixObjectName` (against the real spec helpers).
- RTL: `CreatePackageDialog` derive / track-until-touched / sanitize / validate-gating wiring.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` clean; no new lint errors/warnings.

Refs framework#2694. Closes #2349.
